purpose: Teach: 迷宮/生業/生身/ディテール/恐怖症/遺書/言い渡し/私事

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、原因の迷宮入りした症例を医療チームで再検討します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be reviewing cases with unclear diagnoses as a medical team.
lines.style: Measured and clear. Even breath. Setting expectations like someone who has done this many times before. Steady gaze. Not warm, not cold—professional presence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、看護を生業とする方々の心身ケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we provide physical and mental health support for nursing staff as a medical team.
lines.style: Same composure. A slight lengthening on 'support'—acknowledging this matters. Still even, but with quiet care underneath the clinical delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、生身の患者様の治験記録を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team maintains records for patient clinical trials carefully and securely.
lines.style: Steady, careful emphasis. The word 'securely' lands with weight—this is non-negotiable. No rush. Voice carries the responsibility behind the words.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、症例ディテールの記述を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren, we document case details thoroughly as a medical team.
lines.style: Slight pause before 'thoroughly'—this is deliberate work, not routine. Calm but precise. The kind of care you hear in someone's voice when they refuse to cut corners.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の恐怖症の治療を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren, we treat patient phobias carefully and with full attention as a medical team.
lines.style: Gentle shift here. Still composed, but 'carefully' softens slightly—this is about human fear. Slower pace on that word. Steadiness, but with room for the person beneath the diagnosis.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 終末期の遺書のサポートを、貴院、おこなわれてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital does offer support for end-of-life letters, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Tentative opening. A small breath before the question—Ren is thinking out loud, not challenging. Respectful but genuinely curious. The question lands gently, as if he's been turning this over in his mind.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、診断結果の言い渡しを医療チームで配慮深くおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we communicate diagnoses to patients with deep consideration and compassion.
lines.style: Here, a subtle warmth enters. The word 'compassion' doesn't sound clinical—it's felt. Slower than the previous lines. The voice of someone who understands what it costs a patient to hear bad news.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の私事に関する情報を医療チームで守秘します
lines.en: Ren, we keep all patient personal information confidential as a medical team.
lines.style: Closing with conviction. Slight firmness on 'confidential'—this is sacred ground. Even breath, composed as always, but the words carry the weight of a promise. Professional closure.
